title: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Support Engineer.
description:
We are looking for an experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Support Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AEM Administration, Production Support, Apache Web Server, Dispatcher, and Azure Cloud Infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have experience managing and supporting both AEM On-Premises and AEM as a Cloud Service environments, troubleshooting production issues, maintaining infrastructure stability, and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA). 
 Key Responsibilities :- Administer and provide production support for Adobe Experience Manager On-Premises and AEM as a Cloud Service environments . Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary 
 You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDoxs SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 In this role you will: Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10 or more years building production software. 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. 
 Preferred Qualifications EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 
 Compensation Base salary of 80 to 120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. Stock options. Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. Company cab service for all Noida employees.

Job Information Item Details Job Title QA/QC Engineer Department Engineering / QA-QC Location Chennai, India Reports To Engineering Manager / Engineering & BIM Manager Direct Reports N/A 2. Job Purpose The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all engineering deliverables issued from the Chennai offshore office for UAE and GCC projects are reviewed, checked, and verified against applicable project requirements, contract documents, standards, codes, client and consultant instructions, and company procedures prior to issue. The role acts as a quality assurance and control gate for engineering outputs, with primary responsibility for reconfirming that drawing titles, drawing numbers, project references, revision/status details, codes, administrative requirements, coordination information, and document control standards are fully complied with before submission. The QA/QC Engineer supports the Engineering & BIM Manager, Engineering Manager, and Lead Engineers by ensuring that engineering deliverables are complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant, thereby reducing errors, rework, delays, and rejection risk on UAE and GCC projects. This role is focused on offshore engineering quality control and document compliance, not site inspection or construction QA/QC activities. 3. Key Responsibilities 3.1 Engineering Deliverable Review and Compliance Control Review all engineering deliverables prior to issue, including drawings, submittals, registers, schedules, technical documents, and correspondence. Verify that deliverables comply with contract requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, codes, consultant requirements, and company procedures. Ensure all administrative and technical requirements are correctly reflected before issue. Check that drawing titles, drawing numbers, project references, revision status, discipline references, and issue status are accurate and consistent. Confirm that deliverables are properly categorized, traceable, and issued under the correct project document control system. 3.2 Drawing and Document Quality Assurance Check engineering drawings and related documents for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance with project standards. Verify document formatting, title blocks, revision history, numbering sequence, and approval status. Ensure references, notes, legends, symbols, specifications, and cross-disciplinary coordination information are correctly applied. Confirm that all required attachments, supporting documents, and transmittals are included before issue. Identify omissions, inconsistencies, errors, and non-conformances and ensure they are corrected prior to submission. 3.3 Standards, Codes, and Administrative Verification Reconfirm compliance with applicable local and international codes, project standards, authority requirements, and consultant instructions. Ensure administrative requirements, approval pathways, and document issue procedures are followed. Verify that drawing and submittal packages reflect the latest approved project information. Ensure revision control, issue status, and document classifications are maintained in accordance with project and company systems. Support the maintenance of compliance registers and document control logs as required. 3.4 Coordination with Engineering Teams Coordinate with the Engineering Manager, Lead Engineers, BIM teams, and technical staff to resolve comments and close gaps before issue. Highlight discrepancies, missing information, or conflicts in engineering deliverables to the relevant discipline lead. Support timely correction and re-issue of documents where required. Promote quality awareness across the engineering team and reinforce the importance of first-time-right submissions. 3.5 Offshore Project Support Support the offshore Chennai office in the production and issue of engineering deliverables for UAE and GCC projects. Ensure outputs are suitable for submission to consultants, clients, authorities, and project stakeholders. Assist in maintaining discipline and consistency across multiple concurrent projects. Support timely issue of quality-controlled deliverables to meet project deadlines and avoid delay at site or in approvals. 3.6 QA/QC Audits, Logs, and Reporting Conduct routine QA/QC checks on engineering deliverables and maintain records of findings. Record comments, non-conformances, corrections, and close-out actions. Maintain QA/QC checklists, compliance logs, and issue records for audit and traceability. Provide feedback on recurring issues, trends, and improvement opportunities. Report quality status, document issues, and unresolved concerns to the Engineering Manager or Engineering & BIM Manager. 3.7 Continuous Improvement and Process Discipline Support continuous improvement of engineering review processes, checklists, templates, and document control practices. Recommend enhancements to reduce rework, improve accuracy, and strengthen submission quality. Promote discipline in quality assurance, coding, numbering, and administrative control across engineering deliverables. Support internal awareness of company standards, procedures, and best practices. 4. Qualifications and Experience Degree in Engineering, Construction, or related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in QA/QC, document control, or engineering deliverable checking within MEP or construction environments. Experience in offshore engineering support for UAE or GCC projects is preferred. Knowledge of engineering documentation, drawing control, and compliance processes is essential. 5. Essential Skills and Competencies Strong attention to detail Knowledge of engineering document control and QA/QC processes Ability to verify standards, codes, numbering, titles, and project references Understanding of MEP engineering deliverables and submission workflows Good communication and coordination skills Proficiency in MS Office applications Ability to identify non-conformances and follow up closure Ability to work in a structured offshore environment with multiple project demands 6. Desirable Skills and Competencies Familiarity with UAE/GCC project documentation requirements Experience with engineering review workflows in offshore offices Familiarity with BIM/CDE document environments Experience with QA/QC checklists and engineering transmittal systems Exposure to MEP shop drawing and submittal processes 7. Other Requirements Conduct self and business in line with company Purpose, Vision, Values, Policies, Procedures, and Code of Conduct. Maintain confidentiality, accuracy, and professionalism in all document review activities. Comply with company standards and project-specific document control requirements. Undertake any other reasonable duties as required by management to support business needs.

title: Head of Engineering - EHR Integration
description:
Head of Engineering: EHR Integration 
 Pay: 80 to 120 lakh per year
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
 Type: Full-time
 Hours: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
 Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)
 Department: EHR Integration
 On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday
 Reports to: Chief Technology Officer 
 About XpertDox 
 XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary 
 You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDoxs SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 In this role you will: Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10 or more years building production software. 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. 
 Preferred Qualifications EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 
 Compensation Base salary of 80 to 120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. Stock options. Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. Company cab service for all Noida employees. 
 To Apply Apply at https://careers.xpertdox.com/ . 
 XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) - Bangalore / Pune
description:
Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The Production Support Engineer diagnoses, troubleshoots, and resolves complex production and customer issues across modern banking platform environments. This is a level 2 role: the engineer takes tickets directly from Tier-1 banks, with no first-line team in front, reproduces issues and hands them to the owning engineering team with clear evidence, and keeps the customer informed throughout. The role is hands-on and customer-facing, requiring strong investigation skills, clear communication, and the ability to connect application behavior, Kubernetes infrastructure, logs, metrics, and customer impact. The role offers an advancement path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and platform layers. Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to identify root causes and correlate symptoms across systems. Troubleshoot Kubernetes and container issues, including pods, services, deployments, networking, and resources. Reproduce issues and hand them over to the owning engineering team with logs, traces, timestamps, and steps to reproduce. Customer-Facing Support Engage directly with enterprise banking customers to understand, investigate, and resolve technical issues, including issues caused by changes on the customer's side, such as firewall or network changes, without assigning blame. Acknowledge new issues quickly and give customers regular updates while an investigation is open, even when there is no news. Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders. Observability & AI-Assisted Operations Use tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or similar to investigate behavior. Work with the platform's AI-driven SRE capabilities incident insights, auto-remediation, and AI-based root cause analysis validating findings and acting on them. Improve runbooks, dashboards, alerts, and support processes based on recurring issues and lessons learned. Platform Support Support Kubernetes-based banking platform environments across multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), hybrid, and customer-hosted deployments. Assist with deployment-related troubleshooting when required; deployment ownership is a plus, not a core requirement. In quieter periods, contribute to projects alongside the platform engineering team. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES Technical Expertise 7 to 12 years of Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across production or customer-facing technical environments the single most important capability for this role. Working knowledge of Kubernetes: what pods and services are, how traffic reaches the cluster and moves between pods, and how storage works; hands-on troubleshooting with kubectl. Building or running clusters is not required. Solid Linux troubleshooting, including processes, memory, disk space, and inodes. The platform does not run on Windows. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior. Networking is one of the most common causes of issues on the platform. Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or another relational database, such as replication, primary/replica, and active-passive setups. Deep database administration is not required. Ability to read, interpret, and correlate logs, metrics, traces, and alerts; comfortable using Grafana dashboards, running metric queries, and following traces. The engineer uses these tools and does not need to have built them. Customer-Facing Experience (Mandatory) At least one proven customer-facing technical role is required. Experience working directly with customers during investigations, escalations, or production support scenarios. Operating Style Strong ownership mindset and bias toward resolution. Practical, hands-on problem solver who enjoys investigation and troubleshooting. Works as a peer within a small team. AI-native: integrates LLMs and AI tooling into daily investigation and support work. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, banking platforms, fintech systems, or regulated infrastructure. Familiarity with cloud or hybrid environments such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-prem enterprise deployments. Exposure to deployment workflows, Helm, Terraform, Flux, ArgoCD, Kafka, or distributed databases. Awareness of Kubernetes networking plugins (CNI), for example Cilium. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, working directly with customers, and bringing structure and clarity to complex technical situations. They are hands-on, calm under pressure, and comfortable moving between logs, metrics, customer context, and engineering discussions to get to root cause. This is not an SRE, DevOps, architecture, or platform engineering role, and the engineer does not build or own the infrastructure — engineers looking to architect and build systems will find a better fit in our Platform Engineer openings. For those who want to grow into platform engineering, this role offers a path there, typically over one to two years. IMPACT & SCOPE Direct impact on customer trust, production reliability, and operational continuity for Tier-1 banking institutions. High visibility across customer, support, engineering, platform, and product teams. WHY JOIN This role offers the opportunity to support a next-generation banking platform used by some of the world's largest financial institutions. It combines the technical complexity of Kubernetes-based infrastructure, the urgency of production support, and the customer impact of enterprise banking. Work alongside the platform engineering team on projects, not only on tickets. Gain hands-on exposure to multi-cloud Kubernetes and an AI-driven SRE agent that diagnoses and remediates incidents. A clear path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction.

Key Skills: Production engineering,Customer support,Production support,Kubernetes,Production,Grafana,L2

The candidate will be responsible for translating approved design concepts and 3D renders into accurate, comprehensive, coordinated, and execution-ready technical documentation for luxury residential, hospitality, wellness, and commercial interior projects. GFC Drawings & Technical Detailing Prepare comprehensive GFC drawing sets, including architectural layouts, flooring plans, reflected ceiling plans (RCP), wall elevations, sections, and construction details. Develop detailed drawings for bespoke furniture, joinery, cabinetry, doors, partitions, stone cladding, metalwork, and decorative finishes. Ensure technical drawings accurately reflect approved 3D renders, material selections, and design intent. Prepare detailed junction, fixing, edge, transition, and finishing details. Coordinate drawings with structural, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, fire safety, and other consultants. 2. BOQ Preparation & Quantity Take-Off Prepare detailed, item-wise BOQs with accurate quantity take-offs from architectural drawings. Develop category-wise and subcategory-wise BOQs covering all interior finishes, materials, and architectural elements. Prepare measurement sheets with transparent calculation methodologies. Develop comprehensive technical specifications covering materials, installation methods, finishing requirements, and workmanship standards. Ensure consistency between GFC drawings, BOQ descriptions, quantities, and material schedules. Identify missing items, discrepancies, and scope gaps before tender documentation. 3. Technical Schedules & Documentation Prepare and maintain door, hardware, flooring, wall finish, ceiling, lighting coordination, sanitary fixture, furniture, and joinery schedules. Develop material specification sheets with approved brands, product codes, dimensions, thicknesses, and finishes. Establish unique identification codes linking BOQ items, drawings, schedules, and material approvals. Maintain drawing registers, revision logs, and technical documentation records. 4. Tender & Consultant Coordination Prepare coordinated technical documentation for tender submissions. Review contractor shop drawings for compliance with approved design intent and GFC documentation. Coordinate with vendors, specialist fabricators, and consultants to resolve technical design queries. Identify and report discrepancies between drawings, specifications, BOQs, and site conditions. Support material approval documentation and technical clarification processes. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent relevant qualification. 510 years of experience in technical documentation and interior architectural detailing. Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Excel is mandatory. Strong knowledge of luxury interior materials, joinery, stonework, metal fabrication, glass partitions, ceiling systems, and finishing techniques. Proven experience preparing GFC packages, detailed BOQs, quantity take-offs, and technical schedules. Ability to interpret architectural drawings, 3D visualisations, and complex design details. Working knowledge of construction methodology, material specifications, and coordination requirements. Excellent accuracy, organisational skills, and attention to detail. Preferred Experience Experience with luxury residential, hospitality, spa, wellness, and premium commercial interior projects. Familiarity with Revit/BIM, SketchUp, and other design coordination software. Experience preparing contractor-facing tender packages and comprehensive technical documentation. Key Deliverables The candidate will be expected to independently produce: Complete, coordinated GFC drawing packages. Detailed construction and material junction drawings. Category-wise BOQs with supporting measurement/take-off sheets. Comprehensive material, fixture, hardware, and finish schedules. Tender-ready technical specifications. Drawing-to-BOQ cross-referencing and revision-controlled documentation. Ideal Candidate We are looking for a technically strong architect who understands how interiors are actually constructed , not just how drawings are prepared. The ideal candidate must be capable of independently developing precise technical documentation, identifying design and construction conflicts, and ensuring that no detail is overlooked between the approved design, GFC drawings, BOQ, and schedules. Candidates with strong technical detailing and BOQ experience in high-end interior projects will be preferred.

Job Purpose Deliver accurate, timely and actionable insights for Digital Mobility Products by analysing product-usage and operational data, developing reliable datasets and dashboards, and automating recurring analysis. Partner with product, engineering and business teams to support product performance and customer-experience decisions while applying established data-quality, metric-definition and access-control standards. Own assigned analytics deliverables, with guidance from senior analysts on complex design and governance decisions. Key Responsibilities 1. Translate product and business questions into analysis requirements, agreed KPI definitions and acceptance criteria with product managers and senior analysts.
2. Write and optimise SQL queries using joins, CTEs and window functions to extract, combine and analyse product-usage and operational data.
3. Develop and maintain dimensional models, data marts and semantic datasets for assigned use cases, following approved designs and metric definitions.
4. Build and maintain Power BI or Grafana dashboards; validate calculations, refresh schedules and usability with business users.
5. Analyse product adoption, feature usage, customer journeys and operational trends; investigate anomalies and communicate actionable findings.
6. Use Python or R for data cleaning, exploratory analysis and automation of recurring reports and validation checks; measure the effort saved.
7. Reconcile reports to source systems, monitor completeness and consistency, investigate discrepancies and resolve or escalate issues within agreed SLAs.
8. Apply approved role-based access controls and data-handling practices; maintain dataset definitions, lineage and validation evidence.
9. Collaborate with engineering, data science, product and business teams to clarify instrumentation needs, test changes and support delivery and user acceptance.
10. Manage assigned analytics work to agreed timelines, document assumptions and reusable scripts, and communicate progress, risks and recommendations.

Key Skills: SQL,Data,Python,Software engineering,Data analysis,Software,Engineering

A Billing, Tendering, and Planning Engineer manages the financial, contractual, scheduling, and estimation aspects of construction and infrastructure projects. This role bridges site execution, management, clients, and contractors to ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget. Key Responsibilities1. Billing & Quantity Surveying Prepare and review bills: Draft and process Running Account (RA) bills, final bills, and subcontractor/vendor invoices based on site measurements and work progress. Verify quantities: Conduct site measurements, check drawings against executed work, and maintain measurement books (MB). Reconciliation: Perform material, cement, steel, and cash/advance reconciliations. Payment follow-ups: Coordinate with client representatives, Project Management Consultants (PMC), and accounts teams to certify bills and track timely payments. 2. Tendering & Estimation Analyze tender documents: Review Invitation to Tender (ITT), Bill of Quantities (BOQ), drawings, and technical specifications. Cost estimation & rate analysis: Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity take-offs, and rate analyses for pre-bid and post-bid stages. Variation & extra items: Identify extra work items, prepare variation/change-order claims, and handle contractual correspondence. 3. Project Planning & Control Schedule management: Develop, update, and track master project schedules and baseline programs using tools like MS Project or Primavera (P6). Progress monitoring: Compare actual site progress against planned targets and generate Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Progress Reports (DPR, WPR, MPR) as well as Management Information System (MIS) dashboards. Resource & cost control: Track labor, machinery, and material requirements while monitoring project cash flows and budget variances. 4 . AutoCAD & Technical Drafting Create, update, and modify 2D/3D layouts, structural drawings, and as-built drawings in AutoCAD . Extract quantities, dimensions, and material takeoffs directly from CAD files for billing and estimation. Coordinate with site engineers and project managers to incorporate site modifications into official drawings

title: Tender Executive
description:
Job Description Tender Executive (Mining & Water Treatment) Experience: 25 years
 Location: Visakhapatnam
 Department: Sales / Business Development / Tendering
 Reporting to: Business Head / Sales Head / Tendering Manager Job Summary The Tender Executive will be responsible for end-to-end tender management for the Mining and Water Treatment businesses, covering both Government and Private sector opportunities, including GeM bids and Reverse Auctions (RA). The role involves identifying relevant tenders, analysing tender documents, preparing techno-commercial bids, coordinating internal inputs, ensuring timely and compliant online submissions, and following up through bid evaluation and award stages. The incumbent will work closely with Sales, Technical, Finance, Logistics, Legal, and Business Unit heads to ensure accurate, competitive, and compliant bid submissions within prescribed timelines. Key Responsibilities Tender Identification & Tracking Identify and track relevant tender opportunities from GeM, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, PSU portals, private customer procurement portals, SAP Ariba, Procol, and other e-tendering platforms. Conduct daily and periodic searches for new tenders based on product categories, customer segments, past tender release dates, and business priorities. Maintain a centralised Tender Calendar / Tender Tracker covering tender publication dates, pre-bid meeting dates, clarification deadlines, submission deadlines, bid opening dates, and follow-up requirements. Share a daily/weekly pipeline of identified opportunities with the respective Business Unit heads and sales team. Review tender notifications, corrigenda, amendments, addenda, and pre-bid meeting notices; ensure timely internal communication and action. Tender Analysis & Synopsis Preparation Carefully read and interpret tender documents, including eligibility criteria, scope of supply, technical specifications, commercial terms, payment terms, delivery schedules, EMD/BG requirements, liquidated damages, arbitration clauses, and compliance requirements. Prepare a concise Tender Synopsis / Bid Assessment Note for each opportunity, highlighting scope, customer, location, eligibility, submission deadline, key risks, documentation requirements, pricing inputs required, and recommended go/no-go decision. Coordinate with respective BU heads, product managers, and technical teams for feasibility assessment, product selection, technical compliance, and bid strategy. Maintain a database of past tenders, customer requirements, technical specifications, pricing trends, competitor information, and bid outcomes for future reference and analysis. Bid Preparation & Submission Prepare complete techno-commercial bid documents, including technical offers, compliance statements, deviation statements, product data sheets, MSDS, test certificates, manufacturing licences, quality certificates, past performance references, and other supporting documents. Prepare price quotations, bill of quantities (BOQ), commercial offers, cost sheets, and final bid price in coordination with Sales, Finance, and Business Unit heads. Ensure all bid documents are accurate, complete, properly formatted, digitally signed, and uploaded as per the tender requirements. Submit bids through GeM, SAP Ariba, Procol, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, and customer-specific procurement platforms within the stipulated deadline. Manage online bidding processes, including participation in Reverse Auctions (RA), price revisions, bid tracking, and real-time coordination during auction events. Ensure timely response to tender clarifications, queries, corrigenda, and additional document requests raised before or after bid submission. Documentation, Compliance & Registrations Maintain and update company registrations, vendor registrations, digital signatures, GeM seller profile, product catalogues, certifications, licences, GST details, PAN, MSME/Udyam registration, and other statutory/compliance documents. Manage EMD, tender fees, bid security, bank guarantees, performance guarantees, and related documentation in coordination with Finance and Treasury teams. Ensure timely renewal of expiring documents, certificates, registrations, and bank guarantees. Maintain a well-organised repository of tender documents, submitted bids, technical data, certificates, customer correspondence, and award/rejection records. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Sales, Technical, R&D, Application, Finance, Logistics, Legal, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for timely collection of bid inputs. Follow up with internal stakeholders for pricing approvals, technical clarifications, sample/test requirements, delivery commitments, and authorisation letters. Coordinate with customers, government departments, PSUs, and procurement teams for clarification meetings, pre-bid discussions, document submissions, and tender-related communication. Support Sales and BU teams during bid presentations, technical clarifications, negotiations, and post-bid discussions. Post-Submission Follow-Up Track bid status after submission, including technical evaluation, commercial evaluation, shortlisting, L1 status, negotiations, purchase orders, and award/rejection notifications. Follow up on pending approvals, clarifications, purchase orders, contract formalities, and post-award documentation. Inform relevant stakeholders promptly about bid results, award status, and lessons learned. Support handover of awarded orders to Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics teams for execution. Reporting & MIS Prepare periodic MIS reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, win/loss analysis, conversion ratio, tender pipeline, upcoming deadlines, and pending actions. Maintain records of tender fees, EMD/BG outstanding, bid success rate, customer-wise performance, and product-wise tender participation. Provide insights on pricing trends, competitor participation, recurring tender opportunities, and improvement areas in bid quality and compliance. Key Deliverables Daily/weekly tender opportunity pipeline. Tender calendar and submission tracker. Tender synopsis and bid assessment notes for each opportunity. Complete and compliant techno-commercial bids submitted on time. Updated vendor registrations, certifications, and compliance documents. Reverse auction participation and price strategy support. Tender MIS, win/loss analysis, and periodic management reports. Timely follow-up on clarifications, corrigenda, bid status, and awards. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Government and Private sector tendering processes. Hands-on experience with GeM, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, SAP Ariba, Procol, and other e-tendering platforms. Understanding of Reverse Auction (RA), EMD, Bank Guarantee, L1, technical/commercial evaluation, and public procurement processes. Excellent reading, interpretation, and analytical skills for tender documents. Strong documentation, formatting, and attention to detail. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, PDF editing, and digital signature processes. Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work under strict deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously. Basic understanding of mining, mineral processing, water treatment chemicals, flocculants, polymers, and industrial specialty chemicals will be an added advantage. Familiarity with tender-related commercial terms, payment terms, delivery terms, taxation, and compliance documentation. Educational Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification or certification in supply chain, procurement, or tender management will be an added advantage. Preferred Experience 2–5 years of experience in tender management, e-procurement, bid preparation, sales support, or business development. Experience in mining, minerals, water treatment, chemicals, industrial products, or B2B industrial sales will be preferred. Prior exposure to GeM bids, reverse auctions, PSU tenders, and private-sector e-procurement portals is highly desirable. GeM supports multiple procurement modes, including direct purchase, bidding, and reverse auction.[gem.gov]

 Mechanical Technician (Industrial Machinery Installation & Relocation) Reports to: Installation Project Manager
 Location: Bangalore HQ, with travel within India based on projects
 Travel: Extensive (60-70%) Role Overview The Mechanical Technician carries out the hands-on mechanical work of dismantling, relocating, installing and commissioning high-value industrial assets such as mechanical and hydraulic presses, SPMs, assembly lines and CNC machines. You work on site under the Installation Project Manager’s direction, and your precision and safety discipline directly shape project quality and client trust. Core Responsibilities Installation & Assembly: Position, assemble, level, align and anchor heavy machinery per drawings, OEM manuals and the PM’s instructions. Rigging Support: Assist with lifting, skidding, jacking and transport of heavy equipment, using slings, shackles, cranes, hydra and jacking systems safely. Dismantling & Packing: Disconnect, tag, dismantle and pack machinery for relocation, and record component and fastener details for reassembly. Precision Levelling & Alignment: Use spirit levels, dial gauges, laser or optical instruments and feeler gauges to meet machine tolerances. Integration Support: Connect hydraulic, pneumatic and lubrication lines, and work with electrical technicians during integration and trial runs. Commissioning: Support power-on, dry runs and trial runs, and rectify mechanical issues found during commissioning. Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnose mechanical faults and replace worn parts such as bearings, seals, valves, belts and couplings. Site Readiness Checks: Inspect foundations, anchor points and layout against drawings, and flag deviations to the PM early. Documentation: Maintain daily work logs, checklists, photo records of each stage and inspection reports, and support handover documentation. Safety Compliance: Follow HSE standards, RAMS/ JSA, PPE rules and Lockout/ Tagout (LOTO) protocols, and report incidents and near-misses immediately. Tools & Equipment: Maintain and account for tools, measuring instruments and consumables on site. Qualifications & Experience Education: ITI (Fitter/ Millwright/ Mechanic) or Diploma in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering. A technical certification or associate-level degree is also acceptable. Experience: 3-6 years in machine installation, maintenance, plant engineering or field service. Prior industrial relocation experience is preferred. Technical Skills Reading and interpreting mechanical drawings, foundation layouts, schematics and OEM manuals (basic 2D CAD familiarity is a plus) Basic understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic circuits and P&IDs Hands-on skill with hand and power tools, torque wrenches, alignment and measuring instruments Working knowledge of rigging practices, load handling and anchoring methods Basic ability to read electrical wiring diagrams (preferred) Basic computer skills for logs, reports and CMMS or checklist updates Soft Skills & Operational Demands Communication: Working Hindi is required, and basic English is needed for reports and manuals. Knowledge of the local language is a plus. Reliability: Takes instructions from the PM, follows procedures and asks before deviating. Attention to detail: Careful with tolerances, torque values and records. Pressure handling: Stays composed during tight deadlines and on-site failures. title: Project Manager (storage tank EPC)
description:
Role Summary The Project Manager leads end-to-end delivery of storage tank EPC projects, with accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety and client commitments. The role manages engineering, procurement and construction interfaces, leads multidisciplinary teams, oversees commercial and contractual matters, and drives commissioning, handover and project closeout. Reporting to Director(s) / Vice President Projects, the Project Manager ensures timely decisions, effective risk management and clear reporting throughout project execution. 1. Key Responsibilities Project Management & Planning Lead end-to-end delivery of storage tank EPC projects, with accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety and client commitments; serve as the primary project interface with the client (Sun Petro). Develop and manage the project execution plan, baseline schedule, milestone tracker and resource plan; align head office, site teams, vendors and subcontractors with project priorities. Manage project progress against the baseline, identify delays and risks early, and lead recovery actions and escalation of critical issues. Review and issue weekly/monthly progress reports, MIS and dashboards for management and the client, covering schedule, costs, risks and corrective actions. Chair project reviews, kick-off meetings and client meetings; assign responsibilities, drive decisions within delegated authority and ensure action items are closed. Manage procurement priorities and vendor/subcontractor interfaces with the relevant teams; track material and equipment deliveries against engineering and site requirements. Engineering Management Lead coordination of basic and detailed engineering for storage tanks, ensuring alignment with project scope, construction requirements and delivery milestones. Manage engineering deliverables and review priorities with the engineering team to ensure timely release for procurement and construction. Oversee drawing/document submissions, resolution of client comments and approvals through a controlled document register. Manage interfaces between geotechnical, foundation, civil and tank design teams; assess design changes and control their scope, cost and schedule impacts. Construction & Site Management Direct site mobilization and construction planning with the site in-charge and construction manager, ensuring readiness of temporary facilities, manpower, equipment and construction methodology. Manage delivery of tank erection (jacking / conventional method), welding, NDT, vacuum box and hydrostatic/pneumatic testing, painting and commissioning against approved plans. Ensure construction teams work to approved drawings, WPS/PQR and inspection and test plans (ITPs); drive resolution of quality issues and punch-list closure. Lead the site in-charge, construction manager and supervisors in resolving execution issues, managing interfaces and implementing recovery plans. Quality, Safety & Compliance Ensure QA/QC requirements, inspection hold points and third-party/client inspections are integrated into execution plans; drive corrective actions and closure of non-conformities. Lead implementation of HSE standards, permit-to-work systems and statutory requirements at site; ensure unsafe conditions are escalated and corrective actions are completed. Ensure project compliance with client, statutory and contractual requirements, supported by the responsible technical, quality and safety teams. Commercial & Contract Management Manage project costs against the approved budget, monitor commitments and forecasts, and lead cost control and cash flow planning. Oversee RA bill preparation, measurement certification, variation orders and claims; manage submissions and follow-up to protect project cash flow and contractual entitlements. Manage contract scope and deliverables, flag deviations, and lead change control and commercial discussions within delegated authority. Project Closeout Ensure completion and acceptance of as-built drawings, test records, MDR / final documentation and handover dossiers. Lead project closeout, completion certification and client handover; ensure outstanding actions and lessons-learned documentation are completed. 2. Technical Knowledge & Skills Strong understanding of storage tank design and construction: fixed-roof, foundations (ring wall / piled / raft), annular plates, shell courses, roof structure and seals. Good understanding of tank construction processes (SAW, SMAW, GTAW), WPS/PQR/WPQ, NDT methods (RT, UT, MPI, DPT, vacuum box) and hydro-test procedures. Knowledge of material specifications, MTC verification, surface preparation and coating systems. Proficiency in project planning tools (MS Project / Primavera P6), MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and document control systems; ability to manage baseline schedules, resource plans, progress reporting and recovery plans; working knowledge of AutoCAD for drawing review. Strong understanding of EPC contract administration, project budgeting, cost forecasting, billing, variations and claim management. Sound knowledge of HSE practices at construction sites. 3. Personal Attributes Proactive, results-oriented leader with ownership of project delivery and the ability to align multidisciplinary teams with project objectives. Strong communication and presentation skills in English; Hindi and Gujarati are an advantage. Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills; confident in managing clients, consultants, vendors, subcontractors and site teams. Strong team leadership, delegation, problem-solving and decision-making ability under pressure; sound judgement in prioritising risks and escalating issues. Highly organised, with attention to detail and the ability to manage competing project priorities, resources and deadlines. Willingness to travel to site and client locations as required. 4. Key Performance Indicators Achievement of approved project schedule, milestones and completion commitments. Timely engineering approvals, procurement deliveries and site readiness against the project plan. Safety and quality performance, with a target of zero safety incidents and quality non-conformities, and timely closure of corrective actions. Project cost performance against the approved budget and timely billing and cash flow follow-up. Client satisfaction, quality and timeliness of reporting, and successful project handover and closeout.

title: Construction Safety Manager
description:
Construction Safety Expert 
 We are looking for an experienced Construction Safety Expert responsible for implementing, monitoring, and ensuring compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (EHS) standards across construction and infrastructure project sites. 
 The candidate will be responsible for identifying workplace hazards, conducting safety inspections, monitoring high-risk construction activities, implementing preventive safety measures, and ensuring compliance with applicable statutory requirements and client safety standards. 
 The role involves monitoring civil construction, structural erection, scaffolding, excavation, work at height, lifting operations, electrical safety, and other construction-related activities to ensure a safe working environment for employees, contractors, and project personnel. 
 Roles & Responsibilities Implement and monitor project-specific EHS policies, procedures, and construction safety management systems. Conduct regular site safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments to identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions. Monitor construction activities, including excavation, concreting, reinforcement work, structural fabrication, and erection. Ensure proper implementation of Permit to Work (PTW) systems for all high-risk construction activities. Monitor work-at-height activities and ensure proper implementation of fall protection systems, safety harnesses, lifelines, and safety nets. Supervise scaffolding erection, modification, dismantling, and inspection activities to ensure compliance with safety standards. Monitor rigging, lifting, and crane operations and ensure safe lifting practices at construction sites. Ensure proper implementation of excavation and trenching safety procedures, including shoring, sloping, and barricading. Monitor electrical safety during temporary electrical installations, cable laying, equipment operation, and maintenance activities. Conduct Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), and review Method Statements before commencement of critical activities. Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by employees, workers, and contractors. Conduct safety induction, toolbox talks (TBT), and regular safety awareness training for the workforce. Monitor the safe operation of construction machinery, heavy equipment, cranes, forklifts, and material handling equipment. Ensure proper housekeeping, access and egress arrangements, barricading, and safety signage across the project site. Develop and implement emergency response plans, fire prevention procedures, evacuation arrangements, and mock drills. Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Monitor contractor safety performance and ensure compliance with project-specific EHS requirements. Coordinate with project managers, construction managers, civil engineers, contractors, and EHS teams to resolve safety-related issues. Maintain safety inspection reports, training records, incident reports, PTW records, and other EHS documentation. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly safety performance reports to project management and clients. Ensure compliance with applicable statutory safety requirements, construction regulations, and client EHS standards. Promote a proactive safety culture and drive continuous improvement in construction site safety performance.

title: Head of Engineering - EHR Integration
description:
Head of Engineering: EHR Integration 
 Pay: 80 to 120 lakh per year
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
 Type: Full-time
 Hours: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
 Entity: XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)
 Department: EHR Integration
 On-site or remote: On-site, Monday through Friday
 Reports to: Chief Technology Officer 
 About XpertDox 
 XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), womens health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers. 
 Position Summary 
 You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDoxs SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 In this role you will: Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance. Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim. Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur. Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action. Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production. Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review. Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence. 
 Required Qualifications 
 10 or more years building production software. 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery. Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact. Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations. Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases. 
 Preferred Qualifications EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems. Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data. Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team. Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines. 
 Location and Schedule This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel. 
 Compensation Base salary of 80 to 120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience. Stock options. Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts. Benefits Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy. Company cab service for all Noida employees. 
 To Apply Apply at https://careers.xpertdox.com/ . 
 XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) - Bangalore / Pune
description:
Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing) Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The Production Support Engineer diagnoses, troubleshoots, and resolves complex production and customer issues across modern banking platform environments. This is a level 2 role: the engineer takes tickets directly from Tier-1 banks, with no first-line team in front, reproduces issues and hands them to the owning engineering team with clear evidence, and keeps the customer informed throughout. The role is hands-on and customer-facing, requiring strong investigation skills, clear communication, and the ability to connect application behavior, Kubernetes infrastructure, logs, metrics, and customer impact. The role offers an advancement path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and platform layers. Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to identify root causes and correlate symptoms across systems. Troubleshoot Kubernetes and container issues, including pods, services, deployments, networking, and resources. Reproduce issues and hand them over to the owning engineering team with logs, traces, timestamps, and steps to reproduce. Customer-Facing Support Engage directly with enterprise banking customers to understand, investigate, and resolve technical issues, including issues caused by changes on the customer's side, such as firewall or network changes, without assigning blame. Acknowledge new issues quickly and give customers regular updates while an investigation is open, even when there is no news. Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders. Observability & AI-Assisted Operations Use tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or similar to investigate behavior. Work with the platform's AI-driven SRE capabilities incident insights, auto-remediation, and AI-based root cause analysis validating findings and acting on them. Improve runbooks, dashboards, alerts, and support processes based on recurring issues and lessons learned. Platform Support Support Kubernetes-based banking platform environments across multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), hybrid, and customer-hosted deployments. Assist with deployment-related troubleshooting when required; deployment ownership is a plus, not a core requirement. In quieter periods, contribute to projects alongside the platform engineering team. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES Technical Expertise 7 to 12 years of Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across production or customer-facing technical environments the single most important capability for this role. Working knowledge of Kubernetes: what pods and services are, how traffic reaches the cluster and moves between pods, and how storage works; hands-on troubleshooting with kubectl. Building or running clusters is not required. Solid Linux troubleshooting, including processes, memory, disk space, and inodes. The platform does not run on Windows. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior. Networking is one of the most common causes of issues on the platform. Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or another relational database, such as replication, primary/replica, and active-passive setups. Deep database administration is not required. Ability to read, interpret, and correlate logs, metrics, traces, and alerts; comfortable using Grafana dashboards, running metric queries, and following traces. The engineer uses these tools and does not need to have built them. Customer-Facing Experience (Mandatory) At least one proven customer-facing technical role is required. Experience working directly with customers during investigations, escalations, or production support scenarios. Operating Style Strong ownership mindset and bias toward resolution. Practical, hands-on problem solver who enjoys investigation and troubleshooting. Works as a peer within a small team. AI-native: integrates LLMs and AI tooling into daily investigation and support work. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, banking platforms, fintech systems, or regulated infrastructure. Familiarity with cloud or hybrid environments such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-prem enterprise deployments. Exposure to deployment workflows, Helm, Terraform, Flux, ArgoCD, Kafka, or distributed databases. Awareness of Kubernetes networking plugins (CNI), for example Cilium. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, working directly with customers, and bringing structure and clarity to complex technical situations. They are hands-on, calm under pressure, and comfortable moving between logs, metrics, customer context, and engineering discussions to get to root cause. This is not an SRE, DevOps, architecture, or platform engineering role, and the engineer does not build or own the infrastructure — engineers looking to architect and build systems will find a better fit in our Platform Engineer openings. For those who want to grow into platform engineering, this role offers a path there, typically over one to two years. IMPACT & SCOPE Direct impact on customer trust, production reliability, and operational continuity for Tier-1 banking institutions. High visibility across customer, support, engineering, platform, and product teams. WHY JOIN This role offers the opportunity to support a next-generation banking platform used by some of the world's largest financial institutions. It combines the technical complexity of Kubernetes-based infrastructure, the urgency of production support, and the customer impact of enterprise banking. Work alongside the platform engineering team on projects, not only on tickets. Gain hands-on exposure to multi-cloud Kubernetes and an AI-driven SRE agent that diagnoses and remediates incidents. A clear path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
WE ARE HIRING SENIOR SALES EXECUTIVE B2B SALES | REVENUE GENERATION | DEAL CLOSURE 
 Company: ChalksnBoard (Bodvid Private Limited)
 Location: Gurgaon
 Experience: Upto 7 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time | Work From Office
 Department: Sales & Business Development 
 About the Opportunity 
 ChalksnBoard is looking for an aggressive, ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales Executive who knows how to generate revenue, acquire clients and close business independently. 
 We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls, schedules meetings or forwards leads to someone else for closure. We are looking for a sales professional who can take complete ownership of the sales process, engage directly with decision-makers, understand business requirements, pitch solutions, negotiate commercials and convert opportunities into paying customers. 
 This is a revenue-generating role where individual performance, monthly targets and business closures will define success. 
 We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in high-performance sales environments, especially in the EdTech industry, and have experience handling high-volume sales pipelines, consultative selling, persuasive presentations, objection handling and aggressive revenue targets. 
 What Will You Be Selling? 
 ChalksnBoard works exclusively with the education sector, helping schools, colleges and universities grow through marketing, technology and AI-powered admission solutions. 
 Our portfolio includes: 
 Brand Films & Digital Branding: Premium institutional films, digital video campaigns and brand-building solutions. Digital Marketing & Admission Growth: Meta Ads, Google Ads, lead generation, SEO, social media and admission marketing. AI Admission Ecosystem: AI-powered counsellors, lead nurturing, WhatsApp automation, AI calling and CRM-integrated admission management. Nurtured Leads: Qualified and nurtured admission enquiries for educational institutions. Custom Technology Solutions: AI-powered communication, automation and digital solutions for educational organizations. 
 You will be selling business solutions to school owners, directors, principals, college management and university leadership. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Revenue Generation & New Business Acquisition 
 Independently identify, approach and acquire new institutional clients. Generate business through outbound prospecting, references, networking, inbound enquiries and direct outreach. Build a strong pipeline of prospective schools, colleges and universities. Identify decision-makers and initiate meaningful commercial conversations. Consistently achieve assigned monthly and quarterly revenue targets. 
 2. End-to-End Sales Ownership 
 Own the complete sales cycle, from the first conversation to final deal closure. Conduct discovery calls, client meetings and product presentations. Understand institutional challenges and recommend relevant ChalksnBoard solutions. Prepare and present commercial proposals. Handle objections, pricing negotiations and competitive situations. Independently drive deals towards closure without depending on senior management for routine selling activities. Ensure timely collection of advance payments and signed commercial approvals. 
 3. High-Performance B2B Selling 
 Engage with school owners, trustees, directors, principals, promoters and senior management. Sell high-value services and technology solutions through consultative and value-based selling. Create urgency, communicate business value and demonstrate the commercial benefits of our solutions. Develop the ability to cross-sell and upsell multiple solutions to institutional clients. Build long-term business relationships that generate recurring revenue. 
 4. Sales Pipeline & Performance Management 
 Maintain a healthy and active sales pipeline. Track every opportunity through CRM. Maintain daily records of calls, meetings, proposals, follow-ups and closures. Monitor lead-to-meeting, meeting-to-proposal and proposal-to-closure conversion rates. Provide accurate sales forecasts and revenue projections. Take ownership of individual performance and continuously improve conversion ratios. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 We are looking for someone who demonstrates the following: 
 Proven Revenue Track Record: You can demonstrate how much business you have generated and how consistently you have achieved your targets. Independent Deal Closer: You can take a prospect from the first conversation to a signed agreement and advance payment. Strong Negotiator: You understand objections, pricing psychology, value selling and commercial negotiations. Hunter Mentality: You actively pursue opportunities instead of waiting for leads and instructions. High Ownership: You take responsibility for your pipeline, revenue and closures. Commercial Acumen: You understand how to sell business outcomes rather than simply explain product features. Resilience: You can handle rejection, competition, demanding targets and extended sales cycles. Execution Discipline: You understand that consistent follow-ups, pipeline management and daily activity drive revenue. 
 Preferred Industry & Experience Background 
 We strongly prefer candidates who have worked in high-performance sales organizations, particularly: EdTech and Education Technology Education Sales and Admission Counselling B2B Technology and SaaS Sales High-ticket Consultative Sales Institutional Sales Business Development and Enterprise Sales 
 Candidates with experience in organizations known for structured, high-intensity sales processes, particularly large EdTech companies, will receive strong preference. 
 Experience involving the following will be especially valuable: High-volume prospect engagement and conversion. Target-driven inside sales and field sales. Selling educational programs, technology or institutional solutions. Handling multiple decision-makers. High-ticket deal closures. Strong objection handling and negotiation. Consistently achieving or exceeding monthly revenue targets. 
 Performance Expectations & Compensation Philosophy This is a performance-first position. 
 We believe exceptional salespeople should have the opportunity to earn exceptionally well. 
 Our compensation structure will place significant importance on: 
 Fixed Salary Based on experience, capability and commercial expertise. Monthly Sales Targets – Clearly defined individual revenue targets. Variable Incentives – Directly linked to actual business generated and successful closures. Performance Reviews – Evaluated through measurable revenue and conversion metrics. Important: The variable component is a significant part of this role. Target achievement, revenue generation and deal closures are core expectations, not optional performance parameters. 
 Performance will be reviewed regularly against clearly communicated KPIs and agreed targets. 
 What Makes This Opportunity Different? 
 Direct opportunity to contribute to the company's revenue growth. Exposure to school owners, university leadership and institutional decision-makers. Opportunity to sell multiple high-value services and AI-powered products. High ownership and independence in managing business opportunities. Attractive performance-linked earning potential. Opportunity to grow into senior business development and sales leadership roles based on consistent performance. 
 Application Process We want to understand your actual sales achievements, not just your experience on paper. 
 While applying, please share the following: 
 Total years of B2B sales experience. Previous organizations and industries worked in. Your last drawn CTC and expected CTC. Your average monthly sales target in your previous organization. Your average monthly revenue achievement. Your biggest individual deal closed. Whether you independently handled the complete sales cycle. 
 If you have the confidence to own a number, generate revenue and close deals, we would like to meet you. Apply Now Email: hr@chalksnboard.com 
Website: www.chalksnboard.in 
 CHALKSnBOARD 
 Transforming Education Through Technology & Marketing.

title: Senior Technical Engineer
description:
Job Description Senior Technical Engineer Application Support & Delivery Location: Mumbai / Navi Mumbai (On-site – Bank Locations)
 Experience: 4–7 Years
 Role Type: Senior Individual Contributor 1. Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Technical Engineer to act as the on-site technical representative for application deployment and support at bank locations. The candidate will be responsible for deploying releases using Docker, executing automation scripts, addressing user queries, demonstrating application workflows, and diagnosing live issues through logs and frontend behaviour. When an issue occurs or data gets stuck in the application workflow, the engineer must investigate the root cause, propose a workaround, and report the findings to the Development Engineering team for a permanent resolution. Important: A software development background is essential; however, this is not a coding role. The candidate will not be required to write or modify application code. Strong development fundamentals are necessary to understand application logic, read stack traces, analyse logs, and identify the root cause of technical issues. The role requires independent investigation and problem-solving rather than simply forwarding errors to the development team. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Debugging and Deployment Act as the Level 3 (L3) escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved by L1 and L2 support teams. Diagnose live issues using application logs, server logs, stack traces, and error codes. Identify data, configuration, environment, or application-related faults. Debug frontend behaviour using browser developer tools, including console errors, network calls, and failed API responses. Deploy application releases using Docker, including containers, images, configurations, and environment variables. Execute deployment and automation scripts and troubleshoot script failures. Use SQL queries to investigate and validate suspected issues. Perform root-cause analysis and suggest workarounds or interim solutions. Coordinate with the Development Engineering team for permanent code fixes. B. Client-Facing Support and Delivery Act as the on-site point of contact for application-related queries at bank locations. Address user queries and explain application functionality. Demonstrate end-to-end application processes and workflows. Monitor frontend transactions and identify data or transactions stuck in the application flow. Investigate issues and drive them towards resolution. Report root causes, proposed workarounds, logs, errors, and business impact to the development team. Gather and document requirements from bank stakeholders. Assess feasibility, impact, and risks associated with requirements. Plan, track, and drive delivery activities, including scope, timelines, dependencies, and status reporting. C. Documentation and Team Enablement Prepare runbooks and known-error documentation. Enable L1/L2 support teams to resolve recurring issues independently. Mentor and guide L1/L2 engineers. Participate in the technical escalation and support rotation. 3. Candidate Requirements Essential Skills and Experience 4–7 years of total IT experience, with at least 50% of experience in hands-on software development in any technology stack. Strong understanding of software development fundamentals. Ability to read and understand code without necessarily writing or modifying it. Understanding of program logic, stack traces, and API contracts. Hands-on experience in application and server log analysis. Ability to trace requests across integration points. Experience in frontend debugging using browser developer tools. Knowledge of console, network tab, and request/response payloads. Hands-on experience with Docker, including container deployment, images, configurations, container logs, and shell access. Ability to read, execute, and troubleshoot deployment and automation scripts. Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting capabilities. Working knowledge of SQL for investigation and data validation. Understanding of requirement analysis and project/delivery management. Experience handling L1/L2/L3 support and live issue escalations. Excellent defect reporting and documentation skills. Ability to work with documented runbooks and absorb knowledge transfer. Strong client-facing communication skills. Confidence in conducting application demonstrations and managing stakeholder expectations. Ability to understand and explain end-to-end application workflows. Desirable Skills Experience in regulated or high-trust domains such as KYC, CKYC, payments, fintech, identity, or public digital infrastructure. Familiarity with ITSM tools such as Jira and ServiceNow. Understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes. Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools, structured logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting. Linux command-line knowledge, including server navigation, log monitoring, and process inspection. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Understanding of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines. Project management or Agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or CSM. 4. Technology Environment Docker Log Analysis Browser Developer Tools SQL Shell Scripts Linux CLI Jira / ServiceNow Software Development Background 5. Role Expectations and Clarifications This is a technical application support, debugging, and deployment role. The candidate must have a genuine software development background. Writing or modifying application code is not part of this role. The engineer is expected to independently investigate issues, identify root causes, and suggest workarounds before escalating. Permanent application code fixes will be handled by the Development Engineering team. This is a senior individual-contributor position and does not involve people management. The candidate must be comfortable working on-site at bank locations in Mumbai / Navi Mumbai. Indicative Work Distribution: 30% – Issue diagnosis and L3 debugging 20% – Client-facing application support 20% – Deployment and release operations 15% – Requirements, coordination, and delivery 15% – Defect reporting and L1/L2 enablement
