title: AI Deployment Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE Atlas Engineering & Inspection Services Pvt. Ltd. is building a new Enterprise AI function, and we are hiring its first AI Deployment Engineer. Your initial assignment is an enterprise AI transformation for our client in the United States. You will build with the latest AI coding agents and work with business teams to deploy AI into real workflows securely, cost-effectively and in a way people actually use. We care more about how well you build with agents than years of experience. The role will evolve into a client-facing Forward Deployed Engineering position. 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO Map business workflows with Process Owners and Workflow Champions, identify where AI adds measurable value, and turn needs into clear specifications. Build across the agentic development lifecycle: plan tasks, direct AI coding agents, review and test their output, and ship working, maintainable code. Design, build and deploy AI solutions using large language models, retrieval (RAG), tool use and agent workflows. Integrate AI with enterprise systems, document stores, databases and APIs, with proper authentication, error handling and logging. Integrate AI with legacy and older business software – through APIs where available, and database, file-based or other connectors where not. Build evaluation and testing before each release; monitor accuracy, cost, latency and reliability in production. Analyse and control AI running costs – model usage, tokens, hosting and tools – and choose designs that keep spend low without compromising quality. Apply information-security, access-control and data-handling policies to every deployment. Train and support users so solutions are adopted, and report progress, results and risks clearly to business leaders. 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Experience 0–5 years of experience; freshers with strong, demonstrable agentic development skills are welcome. Working AI/LLM projects built with coding agents (share GitHub or project links); production or enterprise experience is a plus. 
 Essential skills Agentic development (ADLC): building with AI coding agents – planning work, writing clear instructions, reviewing and testing what the agent produces, and fixing what it gets wrong. Good Python (TypeScript is a plus) for services, integrations and automation. Practical LLM engineering: prompting, structured outputs, RAG, tool calling and agent workflows, with testing of accuracy, cost and latency. APIs and enterprise integration: REST, webhooks, OAuth/SSO and connectors to business systems, including legacy software (older databases, on-premises applications, file or batch interfaces). Cost analysis and optimization: estimating and tracking model, token and cloud spend, and keeping it low through model choice, caching, batching and efficient design. SQL and vector databases; cloud, CI/CD, containers, secrets management and access control on a major cloud platform. Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders. 
 Good to have Forward deployed or client-facing engineering; exposure to engineering, inspection, testing or professional-services workflows. 
 B.Tech/BE, MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field preferred; a strong build portfolio may substitute. 
 WORKING ARRANGEMENT Full-time, in our Saket, New Delhi office, 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM IST, Monday–Friday; not remote or hybrid. Liberal, company-funded access to the latest AI coding agents and tools. Up to two working Saturdays a month, as needed for deployment milestones and client deliverables. Full-time commitment; outside work or commercial interests must be disclosed, and external engagements need prior written approval. Strict confidentiality and compliance with security, device, access-control and IP policies.

title: Head Customer Service AVP
description:
Head, Customer Assurance
 Reporting to: Chief Customer Success Officer, B2B / Enterprise
 Portfolio: Connectivity, IoT, CPaaS, security and other enterprise digital services
 
Purpose of the Job
Lead end-to-end customer assurance across B2B customers for connectivity and adjacent digital services. Own and build (where required) customer-journey processes, service commitments, shape assurance and observability requirements, and drive coordinated improvements across network infrastructure, overlay digital platforms and operations. The mandate is to establish hyperscale-grade assurance: predictable reliability, rapid restoration, transparent customer communication and automated operations.
Key Responsibilities
 1. Customer assurance processes. Design standard processes across in-life support, incidents, service requests, changes, renewals and exit. Define assurance ownership, hand-offs, escalation paths and customer communication for each product and bundled service.
 2. Assurance and observability requirements. Define customer- and service-level visibility across Connectivity, IoT, CPaaS and Security, including health, availability, performance, dependencies and customer impact. Establish requirements for proactive detection, service dashboards and customer-facing reporting.
 3. Assurance architecture and platform design. Partner with technology, product and architecture teams to frame the assurance technology architecture and platform designs. Specify service-to-resource mapping, event correlation, ticketing, workflow, define operational acceptance criteria before launch.
 4. Service commitments and restoration standards. Define product- and customer-specific SLAs, service-level objectives, availability and performance measures, and MTTR targets. Align measurement methods, severity definitions, response and restoration commitments, and reporting with delivery capability and customer contracts.
 5. NOC response and customer recovery. Establish the operating interface with NOC, service desks, engineering, partners and product teams. Define customer-impact prioritization, major-incident coordination, escalation, restoration verification, root-cause analysis and closure of preventive actions.
 6. Infrastructure and product reliability. Drive a prioritised improvement backlog with network infrastructure and product owners covering resilience, capacity, redundancy, recovery readiness and recurring defects. Improve serviceability, uptime and product performance through measurable corrective actions.
 7. Process automation and outcome governance. Drive automation of detection, diagnosis, ticket creation, routing, communication, remediation and closure, with appropriate controls. Track SLA attainment, uptime, MTTR, repeat incidents, customer-impact duration, product performance and automation coverage; agree numerical targets after baselining.
 Own: Customer assurance processes, service-quality governance, operational requirements, customer-impact prioritization and the assurance improvement roadmap within approved policies and budgets.
 Jointly agree: SLAs and restoration targets with product, commercial and delivery teams; assurance architecture and platform designs with technology owners; operational readiness and automation controls with Network and engineering .
 Recommend and escalate: Infrastructure investments, platform enhancements, resilience priorities and systemic service risks. Escalate unresolved cross-functional issues through the Chief Customer Success Officer.
Role boundary: accountable for the end-to-end customer assurance framework and improvement outcomes. Infrastructure delivery, platform engineering and day-to-day NOC execution remain with their respective owners, governed through agreed responsibilities and service commitments.
 
Key Competencies / Skills Required
 Has led service assurance or network operations function at scale ideally for enterprise or carrier customers, with accountability for availability and restoration, not just for ticket throughput.
 Technical grounding in IP and transport networks: routing, MPLS, optical and last-mile technologies, and the fault patterns of each. Strong enough to lead escalations personally and to interview & assess technical talent.
 Customer Journey & Process Transformation: Ability to design enterprise service journeys, translate customer needs into operational processes
 Assurance & Observability Platforms: Ability to define service-health visibility, customer-impact models and correlation requirements; contribute to integrated assurance architecture, platform design, operational acceptance.
 Reliability Engineering & Service Management: Ability to define SLAs and service-level objectives, availability and restoration measures; apply incident, problem, change and resilience disciplines to improve customer-facing service reliability.
 AI & Process Automation: Ability to identify and industrialise AI-assisted detection, diagnosis and workflow automation, including controlled closed-loop remediation, with measurable reductions in manual effort and restoration time.
 
Experience and Education
Demonstrated leadership in enterprise customer assurance, service reliability or service operations across Telecom. Experience spanning connectivity and digital services, customer-journey transformation, major-incident governance, SLA management, observability and operational automation.
Proposed education criterion: Degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

title: Principal
description:
About the Role Alpha College of Engineering, Thriumazhisai is seeking an experienced and accomplished Principal to provide strategic academic and administrative leadership for the institution. The Principal will be responsible for driving academic excellence, institutional growth, regulatory compliance, accreditation readiness, research, student development, industry engagement, and operational effectiveness , while strengthening systems and processes across the institution. The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in engineering education and demonstrated leadership experience in positions such as Principal, Dean, Director, HOD or equivalent academic/administrative leadership roles . Key Responsibilities 1. Academic Leadership & Institutional Development Provide strategic leadership for the overall academic functioning and development of the institution. Strengthen teaching-learning practices, academic standards and faculty effectiveness. Monitor academic performance and implement initiatives to improve student outcomes. Promote initiatives focused on student development, employability, industry readiness and placements . Drive continuous improvement in academic processes, curriculum delivery and institutional practices. 2. Regulatory & Statutory Compliance Lead and oversee institutional compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory requirements. Manage and coordinate AICTE approval, compliance and inspection processes . Oversee matters relating to Anna University affiliation, inspections, approvals and university requirements . Ensure timely submission of statutory documentation, reports and institutional data. Maintain institutional readiness for regulatory inspections and reviews. 3. Accreditation & Quality Assurance Provide leadership for NBA, NAAC, NIRF, IQAC and other accreditation and quality-assurance initiatives. Strengthen institutional documentation, quality systems, academic records and evidence-based processes. Drive continuous quality improvement and ensure institutional preparedness for accreditation/assessment processes. 4. Research & Academic Development Promote a strong culture of research, innovation and academic development. Encourage faculty research, publications, consultancy, funded projects, patents and industry collaboration. Identify opportunities for research funding, institutional collaborations and industry-sponsored projects. 5. Admissions & Institutional Growth Work closely with the Management and relevant teams to strengthen student admissions and enrolment . Contribute to institutional growth strategies and student intake planning. Support initiatives to improve the institution's visibility, academic reputation and student appeal. Develop effective strategies for student retention, engagement and overall institutional growth. 6. Administration, Systems & Process Improvement Provide effective administrative leadership across academic and non-academic functions. Review existing systems and introduce process improvement, systemisation and digitalisation initiatives. Establish measurable systems for monitoring institutional performance and accountability. Promote efficient, transparent and technology-enabled administrative practices. 7. Infrastructure & Institutional Resources Identify and plan institutional requirements relating to infrastructure, laboratories, technology and academic facilities . Work with the Management and relevant teams on infrastructure development and resource planning. Ensure that institutional facilities and laboratories support academic, regulatory and student requirements. 8. Faculty & Stakeholder Leadership Lead, mentor and develop faculty and academic leadership teams. Foster a culture of professionalism, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Work effectively with the Management, faculty, students, parents, industry partners, regulatory bodies and other stakeholders. Build strong institutional relationships with universities, professional bodies and industry. Key Qualifications & Experience Ph.D. in an appropriate discipline from a recognized institution. Strong academic background in Engineering / Technology or a related discipline . Significant post-Ph.D. experience in higher education. Substantial experience as a Professor with proven academic leadership experience. Previous experience in a senior leadership position such as Principal, Dean, Director, HOD or equivalent will be preferred. Demonstrated experience in AICTE compliance and inspection processes . Experience with Anna University affiliation, inspections and university-related processes will be highly relevant. Exposure to NBA / NAAC / NIRF / IQAC and quality-assurance processes . Proven experience in academic administration, institutional development and process improvement. Strong understanding of engineering college operations and higher-education regulatory requirements. Leadership Competencies The successful candidate should demonstrate: Strategic academic and institutional leadership Strong administrative and decision-making capabilities Regulatory and accreditation orientation Faculty leadership and team-building skills Student-centric approach Research and innovation orientation Process improvement and digitalisation mindset Strong stakeholder management and communication skills Ability to drive institutional growth and change High degree of integrity, professionalism and accountability What We Are Looking For We are looking for a Principal who can go beyond the routine administration of an engineering college and contribute to its academic strengthening, institutional growth, quality enhancement and long-term development . Candidates should be able to demonstrate measurable contributions made in their previous leadership roles, particularly in areas such as academic performance, accreditation, regulatory compliance, research, admissions, placements, process improvement, digitalisation and institutional development. Application Interested candidates may submit their updated CV , highlighting their academic qualifications, leadership experience, regulatory/accreditation exposure, research contributions and significant institutional initiatives.
